Two Indians achieve Microsoft jobs after facing rejections

Two Indian individuals, Prachiti Parkar and Dirgh Kataria, have secured positions as software engineers at Microsoft after facing significant professional setbacks. Prachiti Parkar was initially rejected by Microsoft India but pursued further studies in the US, eventually joining Microsoft USA. Dirgh Kataria reportedly faced 850 rejections and failed 13 interviews before being hired by Microsoft.
